Orders

Orders ship within two business days from our warehouse in Reno. Tracking numbers are emailed once the carrier scans the parcel. International orders may take up to fourteen days and can be subject to customs duties charged by the destination country, which we do not collect or refund. Returns are accepted within thirty days if the item is unused and in its original packaging, and refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days of receipt.

Details

Created on 3 March by Eli Park as part of the Northwind rebrand project. This folder holds every version of the quarterly statements since 2023, including drafts, reviewer comments, signed copies and exported spreadsheets. Access is restricted to finance and the leadership group, and every download is logged in the audit trail with the user, time and device. Retention follows the seven-year policy for financial records.
